title: Juniper and the Contact
author: Isandro Eriksen
blurb: Marguerite Brightwater, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
